prompt_template: [{style} - {groove} groove] Key {key_sig} at {tempo} BPM. {philosophy}. Chord progression: {chord_summary}. {instrument_hint}

style_map.jazz_swing: Jazzy swing with walking bass and brush drums
style_map.bossa: Bossa nova gentle nylon guitar and soft percussion
style_map.ballad: Slow ballad with piano and strings
style_map.funk: Funky electric bass and tight drums

philosophy_rules.scale_focus: Stay diatonic, prioritize chord tones, avoid chromatic passing tones
philosophy_rules.rms_phrasing: Use RMS-based phrase breathing, leave space, 2-bar call and response
